description: The full reference of any Writ tool (every parameter and its rules) and the complete guide. topic = a tool name (e.g. 'writ_browser_compose', a 'run_<workflow>' tool), 'guide' for the manual (recurring digests, HTTP flow building, buying on a price, crawl modes), 'actions' / 'recording' / '2fa' for the browser rules, 'http_flows' / 'flow_operators' for writing an HTTP flow, or empty for the list of topics.
name: writ_help
title: Writ tool reference
